Some products are delicate, so accuracy, focus and a gentle way of working are important. You will work on different packing lines in a modern food production environment. Together with your colleagues, you make sure the cookies are packed correctly, safely and according to the highest hygiene standards. Please note: a valid European passport, ID card or Dutch stay and work permit is required for this position. What’s your job about?
